test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about the functions of a lube oil pump?

options.text: Provides direction for the oil’s passage through the galleries and to various areas.
Oil is transferred to the engine’s key components under high pressure,.
Maintains consistent oil circulation throughout the engine.
The movement of engine lubricant around the engine is made difficult

solution:
The correct answer is __Option 4**.**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lube oil pump__ is an essential component in the lubrication system of an engine.
 
• It ensures smooth circulation of oil to all key engine components.
 
• The pump facilitates high-pressure transfer of oil to reduce friction and wear.
 
• It maintains consistent flow of oil for efficient engine operation.
 
• Option 4 is incorrect because the movement of engine lubricant is not made difficult; the pump is designed to ensure smooth and efficient movement.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Lubrication System:**

 
 
• The lubrication system reduces friction between moving parts.
 
• It helps in cooling the engine components.
 
• It removes debris and contaminants from the engine.
 
 
 
• **Engine Oil:**
 
 
• Engine oil ensures smooth functioning of the engine by reducing wear and tear.
 
• It prevents corrosion and protects metal parts.
 
 
 
• **Oil Galleries:**
 
 
• Oil galleries are passages through which oil flows to different parts of the engine.
 
• They ensure proper distribution of lubricant.
